Thomas saw Tiffany working at the office from 5pm to 7pm.
The market was closed after 7pm.
Between what times could Tiffany have gone to the market?

Options:
(A) 6am to 12pm
(B) 4pm to 5pm
(C) 5am to 6am
(D) 5pm to 7pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)
